packageRules.description: Node.js follows what Antora supports (antora 3.2.x declares engines.node >=20), not Node's own release cadence. When an Antora update raises that floor, bump .nvmrc and the setup-node version in publish.yml by hand. Matched on depName because the two pins arrive on different datasources: .nvmrc via node-version, and the setup-node input via github-releases (actions/node-versions).
